__NOTOC__ Lanna Skyspark is a Highmountain tauren food vendor found sitting on a bench outside of a small building northwest of Thunder Totem in Highmountain. She is sitting on the bench.

As the conflict progressed, Lanara herself was in charge of the Forlorn Crossing, near the center of the battlefield.

Lassa Skymane is the flight master for Stonehoof Watch in Highmountain.

Lady Latara Feathersong was a consummate huntress of the Sentinels who led the vanguard in many campaigns. She was the wife of Thaedris Feathersong and though her memorial is not as grand or famous as the others in Tel'anor, it holds special importance for him. Her sarcophagus is located at the upper landing. There was potent magic in her bow, its string glowed with a pale light. Only a powerful force could pick it up. Thaedris asked the order leader helping him to retrieve her bow for him, which he believed was stolen by one of the restless spirits of Tel'anor. Lasa the Galerider is a Highmountain tauren flight master at Nesingwary's Trek in Zuldazar.

in the Last Prison.]] The Last Prison (also referred to as the circle of stars) is a titan facility where the ancient mechanism that kept the Old God N'Zoth imprisoned is found. It is located close to the Eternal Palace. During the Alliance and Horde attack to Queen Azshara's palace, the two groups teleported to the Last Prison and fought her, eventually defeating the naga queen. Azshara, however, managed to activate the titan device using the :Heart of Azeroth, finally freeing the God of the Deep after millennia of imprisonment.

:Paladins, I've heard you have many lives. Show me. - Nefarian Lay on Hands is a Holy-based paladin ability that instantly fills your target with life. It is considered an "emergency" ability, in that due to its long cooldown it should only be used when it's really needed. Lay on Hands causes Forbearance. As it allows a paladin to "live twice" by using it, the spell is somewhat famous. Lay on Hands is automatically learned by Holy and Protection paladins.

League of Arathor Emissaries were human Arathi Basin recruiters located at various spots throughout the largest Alliance cities - Stormwind City, Exodar, Darnassus, and Ironforge, as well as the neutral Shattrath City during the monthly Call to Arms: Arathi Basin.

Lavinia Crowe is a Forsaken artisan enchanting trainer located in the Apothecarium in the Undercity. She was married to Gerald Crowe and together they lived in Stratholme before the Third War. When the Scourge came, they were separated and Lavinia was killed. She was later raised and moved to Undercity. She still considers Gerald her husband, despite he married another woman. Unbeknownst to her, an undead named Garth Beeks wanted to be introduced to her.

Lava Burst is a direct damage Shaman class talent that features a strong synergy with Flame Shock. It is automatically learned for Elemental and Restoration shamans. Its short cooldown and its ability to reset with Lava Surge causes the ability to generally dictate the shaman's dps rotation and priorities. Lava Burst also generates maelstrom for Elemental shaman.
The Lazy Flightmaster Placeholder was a hobgoblin located in Prospectus Bay on Mechagon Island.

Legacy of the Mountain King is one of the books that can be found inside Sealed Tomes in the Guardian's Library in Karazhan. Using it grants you a 60 minute buff which increases your armor by 8000 and all magic resistances by 100 for 4 seconds when struck in combat, with a chance of 3%. This proc can stack.
Legacy of the Masters (Part 1) is a book found near the warlock trainers in Orgrimmar, Undercity, Stormwind City, and Ironforge.

Leatherworker Tukhtai is a centaur located in the Ohn'ahran Plains. She is one of the few surviving members of Clan Toghus, having been rescued from the village of Daruukhan after it was destroyed by Clan Nokhud. After she is rescued by Taivan and the player returns to Marukaai, she and the rest of the Toghus survivors can be found near the center of the city, being tended to for their injuries.
Legend: Dragonflight Season 1 is a player vs. player achievement earned by winning 100 Rated Solo Shuffle rounds while at Elite rank during Dragonflight Season 1.
Legend: Dragonflight Season 2 is a player vs. player achievement earned by winning 100 Rated Solo Shuffle rounds while at Elite rank during Dragonflight Season 2.
Legend: Dragonflight Season 3 is a player vs. player achievement earned by winning 100 Rated Solo Shuffle rounds while at Elite rank during Dragonflight Season 3.

Legion Structures are Burning Legion buildings appearing during the Legion Invasions, forming strongholds of different sizes. As with the case of the Black City, these structures can rise up from the ground in moments, spewing forth demons in the blink of an eye. Doom Shrooms, Moongrasses, Chaos Clovers, Bleakthorns and Felblooms are plants that can appear around the fel-scorched ground near these structures.

in the Deeprun Tram.]] Leper gnomes are a diseased, twisted, violent and mutated race of gnomes who wander through the irradiated halls of Gnomeregan. Their minds left crazed by the irradiation of their city, the leper gnomes will attack any who dare enter their city, believing them to be trogg invaders. Due to their exposure to the poisons and radiation of Gnomeregan, eventually, they may devolve further until they become mindless but mostly harmless puddles of toxic sludge. Both Razzle Sprysprocket and Ozzie Togglevolt are trying to find a cure for leper gnomes, and if they manage to do so then gnomes will have both their capital back and the recently cured leper gnomes.

Lenny "Fingers" McCoy is a human in the Old Town of Stormwind City. He also briefly appears at Stormwind Harbor for Alliance players who are on the quests To Be Prepared (Alliance) or The Battle for Broken Shore (Alliance) and have yet to complete the Broken Shore scenario.

Emperor Lei Shen (pronounced LAY-shen), also known as the Thunder King, was the first emperor of the mogu and the most powerful warlord in mogu history. After stealing the power of storms from the titan keeper Ra, Lei Shen united the mogu clans into the first great mogu empire. Able to defeat even an August Celestial in combat, none were able to stop his goals of unifying Pandaria. During his rule, Lei Shen made several significant changes and contributions to Pandaria. The construction of the Serpent's Spine, the great barrier separating the dreaded mantid from the rest of the Empire, is often cited as his greatest achievement. Recently, the Thunder King was resurrected by the mogu's Zandal
Leper Gnome Laborers are located in The Sanctum in Silvermoon City. They are being forced by Sirigna'no to work. One is seen crying in a cage, and two are sleeping.

.]] The term leveling refers to the process of gaining experience in order to level up. It is one of the core systems of World of Warcraft, which can be seen as a game divided in two parts: the game during leveling a character and the end-game. Game features such as new spells are unlocked gradually while leveling in order to ease the overall learning process, and to prepare the player for use of a full set of abilities as well as the widest array of available dungeon and raid instances and other challenges reserved for end-game. It can also be applied to skills where one tries to gain more skill levels or points. Leveling in a manner as quick and efficient as possible is called power leveli

"Let's Do Lunch" is a series of achievements in Cooking, unlocked by completing daily Cooking quests in your faction's capital cities (Alliance = Stormwind, Darnassus, Ironforge / Horde = Orgrimmar, Thunder Bluff, Undercity). The different achievements for each city will eventually unlock a meta-achievement for completing them all.

Lesser Val'kyr maidens were spotted in the skies during the Battle for Andorhal. These Lesser Val'kyr can raise new Forsaken like the original nine bound to Sylvanas but as pointed out during BlizzCon, these lesser Val'kyr are not part of the original pact and are thus not strong enough to revive Sylvanas. Though how exactly they are created remains unknown, it is believed that the main nine Val'kyr have the power to sire these Lesser Val'kyr but if the original Val'kyr, such as in the case of Aradne, is destroyed, the Lesser Val'kyr will dissipate.
Ley Station Moonfall is an underground facility found hidden under the Moon Guard Stronghold in Suramar.
__NOTOC__ Levia Laurence was once a member of the Kirin Tor. Dabbling in shadow magic got her banned from the city of Dalaran. During her experiments she came into contact with Agatha.
The Letter from Ms. Graham is located on the table behind Griftah in the market of the Lower City in Shattrath City. It can be interacted with if the Talisman of True Treasure Tracking is worn.

The Library is a large hoard of knowledge and artifacts within the dwarven capital city of Ironforge. Occupying the eastern section of the Hall of Explorers, the Library is arguably the largest singular building in the city, and is notably also home to a museum and many quest givers. The Library and its contents are administered by the Explorers' League, who are dedicated to collecting knowledge and relics from across Azeroth. Members of the League catalogue and analyze all of their findings in the library. Before coming to Pandaria, Hilda Hornswaggle spent five years here. Leystone Ore is an ore introduced in Legion that can be found all around the Broken Isles. Leystone has absorbed some of the latent ley energies within the Broken Isles. It's described as a warm, glowing rock. Cool to the touch, it reflects light in odd, playful angles. It's light like mithril, but holds much more magical energy than saronite or elementium. The Ironhorn tribe have learned however that it's a sensitive ore, and its power will retreat inward if it's not respectfully extracted, with little waste, from the earth. Lian'tril was an ancient night elf city situated at the base of the northeastern slopes of Highmountain. Its ruins can be found on the coast and beneath the water of Rockaway Shallows. It is not a subzone on the map.
Libation Vendors are nightborne located in Suramar City in Suramar. One of them runs The Nightly - Neighborhood Bar at the Evermoon Bazaar.
Garhan Stornhorn was a legendary Highmountain tauren leatherworker in Highmountain. She changed the way of the tauren when she convinced them to use every component from animal corpses.

The Liberation of Kezan happened 100 years before the opening of the Dark Portal when the goblin slaves to Zandalari trolls on the island of Kezan rose up against their troll overseers armed with technology beyond what the Zandalari possessed. The revolution shattered the trolls' hold over Kezan and the surviving Zandalari fled.

Lieutenant Farren Orinelle was a human quest giver located in Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He had been transferred from Stormwind City to Southshore, something he was not especially pleased about, and was tasked by Marshal Redpath to take care of the murlocs in the area. Unfortunately, he seemed too busy spending his time in the inn, so he sent adventurers to do his job for him. He has not been seen since Southshore was destroyed.

Lieutenant Jocryn Heldric was a level 5 quest giver located just outside Weller's Arsenal in the Trade District in the human city of Stormwind City. He was only available during the Love is in the Air seasonal event.

Light's Point Tower is a scout tower located on the bluffs west and above of Light's Point, just east of the Havenshire Mine northeast of Havenshire. Interestingly, if you visit the Ruins of the Scarlet Enclave in the present, this tower appears as a half destroyed tower instead of being fully destroyed.

Lifeblood is an instant-cast self-buff that grants haste and a small amount of healing, available to herbalists. It is a free, instant buff that increases in power for every 75 skill points in herbalism. The healing portion does not scale with spell power, however, it can crit.
Lieutenant Julek was a quest giver located just outside Silvermoon City in Eversong Woods.

Lieutenant Walden is a human quest giver located in Merchant Square in the worgen starting zone of Gilneas City. He was under Liam Greymane's command to help evacuate the city, but was killed by worgen during their invasion of Gilneas.

The Lift Controls are located at the Maker's Rise in the Halls of Origination during The Halls of Origination. The lift is initially inactive, and power must be routed to the Power Terminal: Maker's Rise before it is usable.
__NOTOC__ Light's Hope Messengers are a human quest giver located at the Trade District in Stormwind City and a Forsaken found in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar.

The Light-Touched Breastplate is a chest most useful for paladins that drops from Watchkeeper Gargolmar in the Hellfire Ramparts wing of Hellfire Citadel on normal difficulty. Despite its caster stats, its three sockets and innate strength and stamina make it best in slot for warriors and death knights for a very long time. Socketed correctly, this item provides either 86 Strength or 115 Stamina.

Lightforged Sentinels are four titan watcher projections that appear in the alcoves of Aggramar's Vault in Stormheim during A Trial of Might. While the player is fighting Yotnar, the latter can cause the sentinels to shoot magic beams using his "Lightforged Defense Matrix" ability. The sentinels despawn at the end of the fight.
Light of the Sun is a Balance druid artifact trait. It is linked to the Falling Star (druid artifact trait) and Touch of the Moon traits.
__NOTOC__ Linore Erona is a blood elf found in the Court of the Sun of Silvermoon City. She stands next to Slidfen and Kraes of Eversong and shares dialogue with both of them.

Lion's Rest is a subzone of Stormwind City, built over the site of the former Park and Old Barracks, previously destroyed by Deathwing. Lion's Rest is a peaceful place dedicated to reflection which commemorates the late King Varian Wrynn as well as those who fell in battle to defend the Alliance. The monument there does not contain the body of the King, as it could not be recovered. King Anduin Wrynn often uses this place to address his people on solemn occasions. After completing The Fallen Lion, Lion's Rest phases and becomes a cenotaph for King Varian Wrynn after he was slain at the Broken Shore, as well as the site of a monument to Stormwind's fallen. __NOTOC__ Lightsong is a small night elf settlement in southern Val'sharah, southwest of the Moonclaw Vale and just east of the road to Azsuna. It has an inn with an innkeeper and a moonwell outside, where Guviena Bladesong gives the quests Where the Wildkin Are and Emerald Sisters.

This is a list of arakkoa towns, which are possibly called veils (which is not always the case). Arakkoa have settlements in Terokkar Forest, Shadowmoon Valley, Hellfire Peninsula and Blade's Edge Mountains. The Sethekk, renegades under the control of Talon King Ikiss, have created their own "veil" within the Sethekk Halls of Auchindoun.

Lireesa Windrunner was the Ranger-General of Silvermoon and wielder of Thas'dorah a few years prior to the First War. She was the mother of the four Windrunner siblings: the three sisters Alleria, Sylvanas, and Vereesa; and the brother Lirath. Since the eldest child, Alleria, refused the mantle of Ranger-General, choosing instead to make more practical use of her abilities as a member of the Farstriders, Thas'dorah remained in Lireesa's hands until tragedy struck: at the onset of the Second War, she and many of her rangers were killed in a bloody attack by the Amani trolls, who had recently allied themselves with the invading Orcish Horde. Lisy Prepfoot is a Highmountain tauren and member of the Prepfoot listening to the sermons of Trand Prepfoot at the Prepfoot Compound in Highmountain.

Loch Modan is a large area east of Dun Morogh, situated in eastern Khaz Modan. It is known for its temperate climate, abandoned archaeological dig site and, until the cataclysm, the huge lake from which the region takes its name. The gray and rugged mountains rise up on all sides around the loch, and the hills are lightly wooded with pine and birch. The loch was held in place by the now broken Stonewrought Dam, an architectural wonder of no equal on Azeroth. The dam was destroyed when Deathwing burst into and flew over Azeroth, and its destruction caused the loch to drain and cause massive changes to the area. Each recipe yields multiple keys which can only be used by blacksmiths with the appropriate blacksmithing skill. , confronting Bwonsamdi, the Loa of Death]] Loa is the name given by trolls to the beings they worship, such as the Wild Gods, beings such as Kith'ix or G'huun, or spirits like wisps. Countless loa exist, most weak, but some very powerful. Most are shapeless, whereas others have animal or creature forms. Powerful, enlightened Zandalari can become loa upon their death - or so it is believed. Many of the loa make their home in the Garden of the Loa in Zuldazar, or across Zandalar more generally, with major temples found in traditional troll lands.
Lizbeth Cromwell is a Forsaken fishing vendor located in the Magic Quarter in the Undercity.

Lobstrok (sometimes pluralized as lobstroks) are a race of humanoid lobsters native to Draenor (and its ) before its destruction. During the destruction of Draenor many of these creatures were killed, however, fortunate ones that were living near the Zangar Sea managed to survive in what later would be called Zangarmarsh. Lobstrok are well adapted to living underwater, but are usually found on beaches and islands similar to the makrura and murlocs of Azeroth. Lobstrok are ravenous carnivores and a large specimen has the capability to devour prey at least as large as a Broken. The insubordination of the naga's Broken slaves is often punished by the feeding of offenders to these monsters.

model.]] Lizards (or skinks) are critters, animals, beasts, and magical beasts found in the Warcraft universe. If a female lizard does not lay her clutch in a well camouflaged aea, her eggs will likely be devoured by Raptors.
Liza Galestride is a Highmountain tauren stable master found at Thunder Totem in Highmountain. She has a pet fox named Kora.
Log is a reputation reward; you must be with Highmountain Tribe to buy this item from in Highmountain for .

Lone wolf runemasters alter the traits of regular runemasters a bit. Many of them travel alone, and have no need of runes that empower others — but extra skill with the fists is always in need. Lone wolf runemasters cannot place or empower runes on any creature or object other than themselves. Thus, they cannot use glyphs at all, and can place sigils only on their own bodies. Lone wolf runemasters are the only runemasters who know the secret of the rune of the flashing blade, though it is merely a simple rune. Lognah is a tauren flight master located at Vendetta Point in the Stonetalon Mountains.

Lok-rath is an Iron Horde village in central , located on an island alongside the Skysong River. It was inhabited by the of orcs, who were stockpiling strange currencies here, quite possibly from another universe. The base was supplied by large war machines from Ironfist Harbor. The enormous garn, Shagor, made its lair in the Terror's Cave near Lok-rath. During the Nagrand campaign, and Yrel led their forces against Lok-rath. The local garrison, led by Uruk Foecleaver, feigned surrender, only to spring a trap against the enemy. In the end, Uruk was defeated, and Lok-rath was secured.
Lohfal Riverhide is a Highmountain tauren that appears south of the Ironhorn Enclave in Highmountain during Respect for the Past.
Longpaws Needs Help! is a bonus objective on Island Expeditions. Its objective differs depending on the island.

The Loom of Fates is a chamber in the Sanctum of Domination where Fatescribe Roh-Kalo resides, located on the southern side of the Crown of Gorgoa up a tall flight of stairs. The room is dominated by the eponymous loom—a system of rings on the floor engraved with Domination runes—which Roh-Kalo can manipulate in order to draw on its power and seemingly influence fate itself. Also included in the room are what appears to be a large telescope pointed southeast out into the Maw, and the anchors of a set of massive chains responsible for pulling the Chained Precipice into the Sanctum.
__NOTOC__ Longclaw Island is a located at the westernmost point of the Azure Span. The island is inhabited by the Longclaw tribe.

Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker is a human paladin and paladin trainer known to be one of the foremost human paladins of the Alliance. He is located in the eastern wing of the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind City, alongside fellow paladin trainers Katherine the Pure and Arthur the Faithful, and later moved in the Sanctum of Light beneath Light's Hope Chapel. He is the chief paladin in Stormwind, a knight of the Order of the Silver Hand, and the one in charge of helping young paladins to get their holy charger. at the lake's center.]] Lordamere Lake (or Lake Lordamere) is one of the largest lakes in the Eastern Kingdoms, rivaled only by Darrowmere Lake to the east. Along with Darrowmere, this lake has been marked by many events that took place around it. Here, many human kingdoms, at the age of the Alliance of Lordaeron, that were prosperous, have been found around the lake's shores and nearby mountains, including Lordaeron, Dalaran and Alterac. Lordamere was very likely given its name from the nearby Capital City of the kingdom of Lordaeron which was built on its northern shores and which was named after Lordain. __NOTOC__ Lord Torvos is a blood elf located on the Terrace of Light in Shattrath City, near the flight master.

Lord Solanar Bloodwrath is a sin'dorei Blood Knight, and Lady Liadrin's second-in-command. He is a quest giver found in the Hall of Blood of Silvermoon City, standing in the room formerly inhabited by M'uru.

Lord Garithos had the unique class "Dark Knight". He has a mix of abilities from the Paladin, Tauren Chieftain and Mountain King hero units - although the versions of "Shockwave" and "Avatar" are extremely different. The use of a paladin spell perhaps suggests the traditional background for a dark knight of being a fallen paladin.

Lord Commander Alexius is the eredar in charge of the Assault on Stormheim. Under his command, the Burning Legion established a foothold on Shield's Rest. He personally emerges from a portal on the island in order to deal with Vethir and the adventurer who sought to liberate it from the Legion. After wounding Vethir, Alexius briefly engaged the heroes before stunning them and ordering his Legion ship to fire upon them. As the demon moves to attack the Gates of Valor, a Val'kyr of Odyn arrives to shield adventures from the ship's blast. Transported to the Gates of Valor, the heroes liberate members of Vethir's brood who then bring them to the Legion ship where the heroes precede to slaughter

Lordaeron Alliance was a group of humans, dwarves and elves under Daelin Proudmoore that attacked the Darkspear tribe on the Echo Isles months following the Battle of Mount Hyjal. After Rexxar had discovered and destroyed the camp of the Human Forces in Durotar, Warchief Thrall sent the mok'nathal to the Isles to help Vol'jin evacuate his trolls to mainland. The Darkspear Chieftain transformed Rexxar, Rokhan, and Chen Stormstout into spirit wyverns and together with troll bat riders destroyed the Lordaeron Alliance navy and land attackers.

A noble human tribe of regimented warriors dwelt in the heart of the Tirisfal Glades. They were led by the great warrior named Lordain, and were considered more refined than the uncouth and savage humans from the mountains. The human tribes of Tirisfal were religious people and had the custom to perform rituals in their shrines across the region. Tyr's Silver Hand was considered sacred by them, and they even had pendants with its image. This was the only tribe powerful enough to end Thoradin's dream of uniting humanity.

__NOTOC__ Lothos Riftwaker is a blood elf quest giver located just outside the entrance to Grinding Quarry in Blackrock Mountain. To get to him, walk down the second chain heading towards Blackrock Depths. He is standing in a small chamber right at the entrance. Just talk to him after having completed the attunement quest at any time and to be teleported into the Molten Core. This also works while you are dead, or not in a raid.

.]] The Lost Fleet (also known as the Doomed Fleet, or the Third Fleet, and the Kul Tiras Third Fleet) are the remnants of the Kul Tiras fleet which was under the command of Derek Proudmoore during the Second War. They were destroyed by red dragons controlled by the Dragonmaw clan and subsequently sunk in Baradin Bay off the coast of northern Bluegill Marsh. The ships located here are named Wave Mistress and Intrepid. A third ship, Flying Osprey, was part of the Third Fleet, but sank south of Menethil Harbor. __NOTOC__ Lotheolan is a blood elf priest trainer located in Sunfury Spire in Silvermoon City. He was present in the Court of the Sun during the closing of the remembrance ceremony.

__NOTOC__ Lost Shandaral Spirits are night elf ghosts that wander most if not all of the ancient ruins in the region of Crystalsong Forest, mainly the Ruins of Shandaral. Some of the Spirits, mostly in the western area of the forest, are neutral but many are also hostile to all players. They appear to be the spirits of the ancient kaldorei race. In order to unlock this service for a location, the player must gain a Manapoof Link by completing a quest related to that location's pet battle scenario. Manapoof Link unlocks are account-wide, and apply to all of the Manapoofs.
Manape Needs Help! is a bonus objective on Island Expeditions. Its objective differs depending on the island.

Mannoroc Coven located directly to the south of Ghost Walker Post and east of Shadowprey Village, is the location of a number of night elven ruins in Desolace. It is named after the dreaded Pit Lord, Mannoroth. The already dead earth has been even further blasted with fel magic by demons that inhabit the area. The magic is thick in the air and travelers will notice that a deadly pall falls over the region upon entering. The infernal, the succubus, the felhound and the felguard stalk the area and are hostile to all foolish enough to pass through. The Manta was killed by Korialstrasz one hundred years before the Battle of Grim Batol with an arrow covered in three drops of a black liquid from a vial.
Mara Rennick is a Forsaken quest giver located in the Magic Quarter in the Undercity. She was said to be new in town. She was only available during the annual Love is in the Air event.

The Manufactory is located inside Blackrock Depths and is accessible from the West Garrison. It is the location of numerous gnome technicians who assemble the parts for the golems that have been carved in the Hall of Crafting before they are sent to the Mold Foundry. The Manufactory's most notable inhabitant is the cruel Golem Lord Argelmach who oversees the production and assembly of these magical machines. This area leads on into the Grim Guzzler, Shadowforge City's famed tavern.

Mark of Nature is a powerful debuff used by the Dragons of Nightmare. It will be applied to a player when he/she dies within a certain radius to a dragon, and is created by another ability called Aura of Nature. Combined with Mark of Nature, Aura of Nature will create a 2-minute stun, forcing the player to sleep and thus preventing any action. The effect's purpose is a fight-"limiter", preventing dying players from corpse running back to the still-alive raid and graveyard zerg the dragons.

Margulf Blaggon is a dwarven miner and author, who spent most his time digging for ore in the mountains of Khaz Modan. During his time there he wrote the book Stresses of Iron, which players seeking to help Brother Kristoff in Stormwind City have to find a copy of, in the quest Speaking of Fortitude.

Mariq Dotur is the late sister of Khanam Matra Sarest. Martha Strain is a Forsaken warlock located in the Magic Quarter in the Undercity. She moved to Dreadscar Rift when the Council of the Black Harvest defeated Jagganoth and elected a new leader.

Mass Resurrection was a active guild perk ability that resurrects all raid and party members. Characters needed to be level 28 or higher to cast this. It hits non-guild members and guild members alike in the same raid or party group. The ability has no cooldown, but a player can only be resurrected by Mass Resurrection once every 10 minutes, so in most cases a group will not use it more frequently than that anyway. The timer is indicated by a debuff icon, similar to those of bloodlust effects.

Massive Power Sources are crystals located throughout Valdrakken, while the Arcane Forge is being empowered. Clicking on one will place a large orb of energy over the player's head and significantly reduce their movement speed; they must throw it to another player in order to get it to the Arcane Forge. It is worth 5 units of Energy.

Master Shapeshifter is a druid talent in the second tier of the Restoration tree. It requires two points in the Natural Shapeshifter talent. The talent grants one of four passive bonuses, depending on the druid's form, increasing physical damage dealt in Bear Form by 4%, increasing critical strike chance in Cat Form by 4%, increasing spell damage in Moonkin Form by 4%, and increasing healing done in caster and Tree of Life (druid ability) form by 4%.
__NOTOC__ Matron Alesso is a high elf priest trainer located in the Silver Enclave in the mage city of Dalaran. She was present in the city when it was above Deadwind Pass.

They would then reconfigure the re-origination device to bring the end of all life on Azeroth, with the aid of the Tol'vir. Matron Mother Malevolence is a shivarra located at the Seat of Command and Illidari Foothold on Mardum. She is accompanied by Priestesses of Delight, Shivarra Destroyers, and Priestesses of Dementia. By her own admission, she joined the Illidari with other shivarra after Illidan defeated their former leader, Magtheridon because she considered Sargeras "a bore" and felt that there was no fun in his goal to destroy all life.
Master of Magic is earned for beating 12 of the trainers listed with a team composed only by magic pets.

Melli Spalding is a Tidesage that was apart of the crew on the Bold Arva commanded by Flynn Fairwind that aided Mathias Shaw in his mission to check the costs of Zandalar for signs that the Banshee loyalists were on the island. She quickly put out the fire that erupted on the ship during the storm. Mend Pet is a level 5 hunter ability. This is a hunter's primary method of healing their pet. In the spellbook, this ability is found inside the Pet Utility button. It also shares a button with Revive Pet; when you have a pet out and alive, Mend Pet will show on the shared button. When your pet is dead or you don't have a pet summoned, Revive Pet will show instead.
